job.job_title: Java + GenAI Enablement Engineer | GitHub Copilot Adoption
job.job_description:
We are looking for a passionate AI Developer Enablement Engineer to drive GitHub Copilot adoption across engineering teams. In this role, you will help developers maximize the value of AI-assisted software development by coaching teams, promoting best practices, and enabling seamless adoption of GitHub Copilot and other AI-powered developer tools.




This is an excellent opportunity for professionals who enjoy combining software engineering expertise, AI tools, developer productivity, and stakeholder engagement to transform the software development lifecycle.




Key Responsibilities

Coach and mentor engineering teams on effective usage of GitHub Copilot and AI-assisted development tools.
Guide developers in leveraging AI for code generation, code optimization, documentation, debugging, code reviews, and unit test creation.
Understand development workflows and recommend AI-native engineering best practices.
Drive onboarding, adoption, and continuous enablement activities across customer teams.
Conduct technical workshops, knowledge-sharing sessions, live demos, and hands-on training.
Track adoption metrics, collect user feedback, and recommend continuous improvements.
Prepare user guides, best practice documentation, FAQs, and process documentation.
Collaborate with Agile teams, product owners, and support teams to resolve adoption challenges.
Participate in client meetings, adoption reviews, and stakeholder discussions to ensure successful AI transformation.



Required Skills

Strong software development experience with Java, Python, or modern application development.
Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot or AI coding assistants such as Cursor, Claude Code, or Gemini Code Assist.
Good understanding of SDLC, Agile/Scrum methodologies, coding standards, and developer workflows.
Excellent communication, coaching, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work with cross-functional teams and customer-facing environments.



Preferred Skills

Experience with Java, Python, Angular, or React.
Knowledge of GitHub, Git, CI/CD pipelines, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions.
Familiarity with Generative AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, and AI developer productivity tools.
Experience driving platform adoption, developer enablement, technical training, or engineering transformation initiatives.



Why Join EPAM?

Work on cutting-edge AI Developer Productivity initiatives.
Help engineering teams adopt the latest AI technologies at scale.
Collaborate with global clients and highly skilled engineering teams.
Opportunity to work with GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, LLMs, and AI-native software engineering practices.
Continuous learning and career growth in one of the fastest-growing areas of software engineering.



Skills: GitHub Copilot, AI Developer Tools, Generative AI, LLM, Java, Python, Agile, SDLC, CI/CD, GitHub, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Prompt Engineering, Developer Enablement, Technical Coaching, Stakeholder Management, Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini, React, Angular.
